_description: Intentional schema adapters — documented differences between SQL and API contracts

adapters.reason: SQL 'type' is a reserved word in many ORMs; API uses 'job_type' for clarity
SQL stores raw JSONB as 'input'; API exposes as 'parameters' for clarity
SQL uses short 'error'; API uses 'error_message' for consistency with error patterns
SQL stores full JSONB output; API extracts only asset IDs for the response
Progress is internal worker state; clients poll separate progress endpoint
Internal retry state not exposed to API consumers
Internal retry configuration not exposed to API consumers
Internal worker routing detail; gpu_provider and gpu_instance_id exposed instead
Project association exists in SQL but not yet exposed in v1 API (pending project feature)
JSONB field with flexible structure; exposed via dedicated /talent/{id}/dna endpoint
Physical attributes (height, hair_color, eye_color, body_type) omitted from base response; available via extended endpoint
